changeSet.author: TDuric
changeSet.comment: If this view is changed, this also needs to be updated in procedure [dbo].[GenerateAllAssetTypeDisplayValues]
changeSet.sql:
create view [workflow].[ItemAsset] WITH SCHEMABINDING as select wi.id as WorkFlowItemId, cast(coalesce(substring(adv.displayvalue,0,850),'(unknown)') as nvarchar(850)) as AssetName from [workflow].[type] wt inner join [workflow].[version] wv on (wt.id = wv.typeid) inner join [workflow].[item] wi on (wv.id = wi.versionid) inner join [dbo].asset ass on(ass.[object] = wi.[object] and ass.[objectid] = wi.[objectid]) inner join dbo.AssetDisplayValue adv on assetid = ass.id go
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'CIX_WorkflowItemAsset') BEGIN CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX CIX_WorkflowItemAsset ON [workflow].[ItemAsset](WorkFlowItemId); END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_CIX_WorkflowItemAsset_AssetName') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_CIX_WorkflowItemAsset_AssetName ON [workflow].[ItemAsset](AssetName); END
